The statements the node runs with the settings and schema sent, unsaved
edits included: the poll, a record's reads, and the updates that set a
record to Processing or Failed - written as the node writes them
(SCHMdbSource), with `identifier` for the record. Doesn't connect. When
the node would refuse to start, `problem` says why instead.
